items.name: line-grid-pattern
items.description: A rectangular grid of lines in a fixed box, with minor lines between the major ones and an offset that scrolls it.

items.name: dot-grid-pattern
items.description: A field of dots on the same divisions and offset as a line grid, so one laid over the other lines up.

items.name: grid-pattern
items.description: An infinite world-anchored line grid that fills whatever the camera can see, with dashes locked to the world.
